admin.title: Admin panel
admin.section.origins.hint: Applies to the v1 API only
admin.users.confirmDelete: Delete the account "{username}"? This cannot be undone.
admin.origins.scope: The allowlist applies to the HTTP v1 API only ({path}). The web UI is never affected — it keeps working even with an empty list.
admin.origins.emptyMeans: An empty allowlist means nobody can use v1.
admin.origins.lockoutWarning: Remember to add your own domain, so you do not lock yourself out.
admin.origins.syntax.wildcard: any subdomain (not the bare domain itself)
admin.origins.syntax.match: only the listed subdomains within the range
admin.origins.syntax.noGraph: this origin may not use the graph engine
admin.origins.empty: Allowlist is empty — v1 is currently unavailable
admin.blocked.scope: The blocklist stops both the web UI and v1, returning 403 immediately.
admin.blocked.priority: It takes precedence over the allowlist: the blocklist is checked first, and a match returns right away without any further evaluation. Only requests that are not blocked go on to the web UI or the allowlist.
admin.blocked.warning: Same syntax as the allowlist. Do not add your own address — there is no second safety net here.
admin.blocked.placeholder: Domain or IP; wildcards and modifiers supported
